reconstruction.topology: Two ideal voltage sources joined at a single islanded load bus through individual lossless series reactances Xv_i + omega_n Ls_i. Use paper Figs. 2–4 and companion TSG Fig. 6 and Eqs. (7)–(15). Inner loops and LC dynamics are omitted in the paper's outer-loop model. Each converter uses the same 5 kW base.
reconstruction.nominal_operating_point_basis: Pre-disturbance nominal frequency, active references delivered, internal and bus voltages 1 p.u. Line phase angles follow the sinusoidal power-flow equation. The paper does not list numerical K1, K2, bus voltage, or operating angles.

sensitivity.alternative_preload_basis: If Table I's p_load*=0.5 means total pre-step load (instead of the described 0.5 increment), equal droop shares it equally. Retain fixed 1 p.u. voltages for this deviation.
sensitivity.bus_voltage_basis: Bounds from the companion TSG discussion of normal load-bus operation. Keep nominal per-converter active dispatch.

reconstruction.comparison_basis: Published curves are evaluation inputs only. No power-flow values or controller gains are estimated or tuned from the curves. Figure 9 reports both the three rightmost poles and other nearby poles because source markers include extra poles for k12=70 and overlap for some gains.
